pr_title: core/vm: deep copy jumptable when enabling extra eips
pr_comments:
The `NewEVMInterpreter` + extra eips is not meant for production use, but rather to run or generate tests. In any scenario where an actual production hardfork is configured, a separate instruction table is created, and the changes applied to that instruction table. Like this: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/d30e39b2f833fb75f1e529cd405061fb6b548b8d/core/vm/jump_table.go#L111

All the instruction tables are separate, and defined here: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/d30e39b2f833fb75f1e529cd405061fb6b548b8d/core/vm/jump_table.go#L47  

I'm interested in the root issue reported in #26136, what the actual background is where this was found to be a problem @yihuang ?

> I'm interested in the root issue reported in #26136, what the actual background is where this was found to be a problem @yihuang ?

it's used in [ethermint](https://github.com/evmos/ethermint/blob/main/x/evm/keeper/state_transition.go#L119)

issue_context.title: Problem: extra-eips is not concurrency safe
issue_context.body:
#### System information

Geth version: `v1.10.19`+
CL client & version: e.g. lighthouse/nimbus/prysm@v1.0.0
OS & Version: Windows/Linux/OSX
Commit hash : (if `develop`)

#### Expected behaviour

Multiple evm instances created with `NewEVM` should be safe to use concurrently.

#### Actual behaviour

They'll interleave each other when extra-eips exists.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

- Set some extra-eips in the config
- Start multiple thread, in each thread, create separate evm instance and execute the same contract with same context.
- The contract results will defer.

````
[backtrace]
````
